records.name: Selective premise-sensitive revalidation of assurance and requirements

assumptions.CHANGED_ASSUMPTION_TEST: Reassess support when these prerequisites change; the observable consequence remains: Affected claims are re-supported, narrowed, suspended or withdrawn; independent warrants are not erased.
assumptions.REQUIRED: Dependency information and the distinction between invalidated support and falsified conclusion.

source_obligation.authority: Authorised change owner and assurance consumer decide scope; successor implementation does not warrant itself.
source_obligation.cheap_path: No revalidation is needed for a proved irrelevant change; a targeted regression may suffice.
source_obligation.criterion: A material change causes affected support/applicability and acceptance obligations to be re-examined at the appropriate scope. Changed assumptions may invalidate support without logically falsifying the conclusion; unaffected evidence is not discarded indiscriminately.
source_obligation.mechanism: Trace a change to the claims and evidence whose premises it affects, then re-evaluate the affected support while preserving independent valid evidence.
source_obligation.trigger: Requirements, semantics, implementation, permissions, membership, model or environment assumptions change.
